variants.default: primary action button: submit, send, add to cart, main call to action
variants.outline: secondary action in a toolbar or header, e.g. share, export, summarize, filter
variants.secondary: secondary or cancel action button with a subtle background
variants.ghost: low-emphasis icon or toolbar button with no background
variants.destructive: button for delete, remove, or other irreversible actions

variants.secondary: neutral label or tag, e.g. a category, count or time window
variants.success: positive status label, e.g. in stock, paid, active
variants.warning: cautionary status label, e.g. low stock, pending, act today
variants.destructive: error or failed status label, e.g. out of stock, payment failed

variants.default: dropdown for choosing one option from a list, e.g. a model, plan, or filter

variants.warning: warning message banner, e.g. shipping delays, action needed soon
variants.destructive: error message banner, e.g. payment failed, form errors
